info.title: Labs API
info.description: API for integrating lab diagnostics — availability checks, package catalog, order management, report retrieval, and health camps. All requests must include a valid `ls-api-key` header.

ApiKeyAuth.description: API key issued by LabStack. Pass this in every request header.

post.description: Creates an order for the authenticated store. Provide packageIds and/or testIds. pincode is always required; address/city/state are additionally required for HOME_SAMPLE orders. Either dateOfBirth or age must be provided. orderType CAMP is not accepted by this endpoint. uniqueId is optional (auto-generated when omitted). Optionally generates a Razorpay payment link when payment is required; that link is valid for 15 minutes and the order is auto-cancelled if payment is not completed in that window.

example.message: Raw values for order 47585 are being extracted. Check back in a few minutes, or wait for the HARMONIZED_VALUES_CHANGED order webhook.

parameters.name: orderId

get.description: Returns standardized test values for an order; available only when the order status is REPORT_DELIVERED. If the values have not been generated yet and the order has a valid report, extraction is started automatically and a 202 is returned — retry the call in a few minutes, or wait for the HARMONIZED_VALUES_CHANGED order webhook. Extraction is attempted at most once per order, so a 400 means the values are not going to become available without LabStack support.

parameters.name: labIds
parameters.description: Optional. Comma-separated lab ids (as returned by List labs). Only tests offered by these labs are returned. Every id must be a lab in your store network, otherwise the request fails. A lab that is in your network but temporarily unavailable is accepted and simply contributes no tests, so the response can be empty rather than an error.

get.description: Returns all active tests supported by labs enabled for the authenticated store. Optionally filter to tests offered by labs that service a given pincode or lat/long — when a location filter is supplied the response may be delayed while labs are queried. Tests can also be restricted to specific labs via `labIds`. Filters combine, so a test is only returned if it is offered by a lab that satisfies every filter supplied. See Appendix (Test Category) for the possible `category` values.
